markscheme.html:
a

Atoms have discrete/quantized energy levels;
An electron absorbs a photon to move to a higher energy level;
The photon energy must equal the difference between energy levels, so only specific wavelengths are absorbed (creating dark lines in a continuous spectrum);

For the third mark, the link between energy difference and specific absorbed wavelengths from a continuous spectrum must be clear.

b

E₂ - E₁ = (E₂ - E₀) - (E₁ - E₀) = hc/λ₂₀ - hc/λ₁₀;
= 1240 eV nm × (1/309 nm - 1/514 nm) = 1.60 eV;

Award [1] for correct method showing subtraction of energies (or calculation of individual energies in eV and then subtraction). Award [1] for correct final answer to 3 s.f. Answer must be in eV. Allow answers in range 1.59-1.61 eV due to rounding of constants.
